fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Adversaries may look for details about the network configuration and settings of systems they access or through information discovery of remote systems
fields.name: Suspicious Network Command
fields.notes:
- To move around freely without attracting too much attention, attackers often use reliable software (one of the favorites is psexec) that looks normal in an enterprise environment.
- Use the following aggregate to easily group by endpoint: `| group array_agg_distinct(dst.ip.address) by endpoint.name, src.process.cmdline`
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "ipconfig /all" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "netsh interface show interface" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "arp -a" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "nbtstat -n" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "net config" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "route print"))
